speaker: marty
flavor: Boss! My phone won't stop ringing. Don't panic. Okay, panic a little.
title: The first truck is stuck
text: The truck carrying the capsule frame is stuck two states away. Nothing can be built until it gets here.

choices.label: Pay $10M for a fast courier
choices.result: A courier races the frame over. It arrives the same night.

choices.label: Wait three days
choices.result: The truck rolls in three days late. The team gets to work.

choices.label: Reroute the truck
choices.result: One clever detour later, the frame arrives the next morning.

speaker: marty
flavor: I counted that pallet three times. Thrice! Now it's gone.
title: A shipment goes missing
text: A pallet of fuel valves has vanished from the loading dock. The capsule can't be finished without them.

choices.label: Pay to rush a new one
choices.result: One very expensive phone call later, new valves are on the way.

choices.label: Wait for the next truck
choices.result: A week of waiting. The valves finally arrive.

choices.label: Have an engineer make one
choices.result: The new valve is a little rough, but it fits.

speaker: rosa
flavor: It's like unplugging the TV in a storm. A little care now saves a lot later.
title: A storm rolls over the pad
text: A thunderstorm hits while the rocket is being put together. Lightning lands close to the pad.

choices.label: Install lightning protection
choices.result: Tall rods now guard the pad. A strike is far less likely to reach the rocket.

choices.label: Skip it
choices.result: The storm passes. The pad stays as it is.

speaker: hal
flavor: I think I've seen this film before and I really don't like how it ends.
title: A line in the weld
text: A scan shows a faint line in one of the capsule's welds. It may be a crack. It may be nothing.

choices.label: Ask the inspector to check it
choices.result: A careful check finds a small flaw. It gets fixed in a day.

choices.label: Take it apart and check by hand
choices.result: Four slow days. The weld is redone and it is solid.

choices.label: Ship it as it is
choices.result: The capsule moves on. Nobody knows what that line was.

speaker: dev
flavor: Cool cool cool. So the pretend rocket crashed. Only the pretend one!
title: The simulator finds a bug
text: A practice flight in the simulator crashed. There is a bug in the flight software.

choices.label: Fix it now
choices.result: Two days of careful work. The bug is gone and tested.

choices.label: Patch it later
choices.result: The bug goes on a to-do list. Uh- oh, the list is getting long.

speaker: marty
flavor: They went bust while I was on hold, boss! I'm STILL on hold! Don't panic.
title: The valve supplier goes bust
text: The company that makes our valves just went out of business. Their last email was only a sad face.

choices.label: Pay a premium supplier
choices.result: The fancy valves arrive in a velvet-lined crate. They cost like it, too.

choices.label: Switch to the backup supplier
choices.result: The backup supplier is slow but real. Three days later: valves.

choices.label: Wait for the bankruptcy sale
choices.result: Ten days later you win the valves at auction. Also, by accident, a forklift.

speaker: hal
flavor: Inches. Millimeters. Pick one. Trust, I've seen this movie before.
title: Inches or millimeters?
text: A contractor sent part sizes in inches. Our plans use millimeters. Nobody is sure which numbers got mixed.

choices.label: Audit every hand-off
choices.result: Two days of rulers and red pens. Three mix-ups found and fixed.

outcomes.result: Everything fits. This time, the paperwork was right.
A bracket shows up 25 times too big. It is now the break room table.

speaker: hal
flavor: Old code. New flight. Bad sequel to the movie I talked about before.
title: The old software still runs
text: The reused booster still has its old guidance software. It worked on the last rocket. Do we test it again?

choices.label: Retest it in the simulator
choices.result: The simulator runs it all night and it passes. Three days well spent.

choices.label: Skip the retest
choices.result: You save three days. The old software hums along, untested.

speaker: hal
flavor: Pad's frozen. My coffee froze too. Don't ask how I know.
title: Frost on the launch pad
text: The launch pad was white with frost this morning. Cold makes rubber seals stiff, and stiff seals can leak.

choices.label: Install pad heaters
choices.result: Heaters go in. The pad is now the warmest spot in town. The birds have noticed.

choices.label: Hope for warm days
choices.result: You bet on sunshine. The frost makes no promises.

speaker: marty
flavor: Three people in my office, boss. One brought a pie chart. Okay, panic a little.
title: The team asks for a raise
text: The team is tired and asks for a raise. One of them made a chart. The chart is very convincing.

choices.label: Give raises
choices.result: Raises all around. Someone frames the chart.

outcomes.result: The team grumbles and gets back to work. The chart stays on the wall, staring back.
One person packs a box and leaves. They take the good stapler.

speaker: rosa
flavor: A road trip is not a race. The car that speeds is the one that gets the ticket.
title: Zenith moves up its launch
text: Zenith Aerospace says it will launch early. Their press release has four exclamation marks.

choices.label: Crunch time
choices.result: Late nights, cold pizza, fast work. The build jumps ahead. So do the yawns.

choices.label: Stay the course
choices.result: You stick to the plan. The whole team breathes out.

speaker: tasha
flavor: A mystery donor who loves rockets! 'Tiny Agency, Giant Heart.' That's a headline!
title: A donor calls
text: A rich fan of spaceflight wants to give money. They only ask to name one bolt after their cat. Cute, right?!

choices.label: Accept quietly
choices.result: The money lands. One bolt is now named Mr. Whiskers.

choices.label: Accept and hold a public event
choices.result: A day of speeches and tiny sandwiches. Mr. Whiskers the bolt gets the applause he deserves .

speaker: rosa
flavor: Even a good stew needs time off the heat. So do people.
title: The team looks worn out
text: The team is running on coffee and stubbornness. Someone fell asleep on a blueprint.

choices.label: Pizza night
choices.result: Pizza for everyone. The pineapple debate lasts two hours. Spirits soar.

choices.label: Keep working
choices.result: Work goes on. The blueprint now has a small drool mark. Gross!!!

speaker: crew

flavor.amara: One more sim run. I already know it all. Easy. But one more.
flavor.jun: Technically, the simulator and I are not done talking.
flavor.lucia: I would like more sim time. Breathe. Then decide. I decided.
flavor.dmitri: In my day, we trained until the simulator begged for mercy.
flavor.priya: Sorry, quick question. Could I maybe have forty more hours in the sim?
flavor.sam: More sim time, boss? I promise to crash it only twice.
flavor.zainab: The last run was nearly perfect. One more check. Maybe nine.
flavor.mateo: Can we do the sim again? I forgot the middle part. Wait, did we do that?

title: More simulator time
text: The crew asks for extra time in the flight simulator. It costs a little money and a day.

choices.label: Approve it
choices.result: A long day in the simulator. The crew comes out sharper and very very hungry.

choices.label: Decline
choices.result: The simulator stays dark. The crew practices in their heads instead. Yikes!

speaker: marty
flavor: The captain says 'soon,' boss. Soon! That is not a time! Don't panic.
title: Parts stuck at sea
text: Parts for the faraway launch site are late. The cargo ship is somewhere in the ocean, going slowly, like very slowly.

choices.label: Pay for air freight
choices.result: The parts fly first class. They arrive well-rested and on time.

choices.label: Wait for the ship
choices.result: Four days later the ship drifts in. The captain waves like nothing happened.

choices.label: Pre-clear customs
choices.result: The paperwork is done before the ship docks. The parts roll right through.

speaker: rosa
flavor: A budget is like a grocery list. It only works if you read it at the store.
title: Money is draining fast
text: The money is going faster than planned. Nobody can explain the line that says 'misc. rocket stuff.'

choices.label: Do a cost review
choices.result: Two dull days with a calculator. You find $15M hiding in the budget. Crazy huh?

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: The spreadsheet stays closed. It grows quietly in the dark.

speaker: hal
flavor: No power. No fans. It was truly a sweaty day.
title: The power goes out
text: A heat wave knocked out power to the workshop. The tools are off and the ice cream is in danger. Our precious dessert is melting.

choices.label: Rent generators
choices.result: The generators roar to life. The tools work. The ice cream is saved.

choices.label: Work nights
choices.result: The team works after dark when it is cooler. Everyone is sleepy and a bit cranky. Quick, before they turn to zombies!

speaker: tasha
flavor: A reporter! Cameras! 'Little Agency, Big Dreams.' Again, that's a headline!
title: A reporter wants a tour
text: A reporter wants to visit the workshop. Someone should hide the whiteboard that says 'DO NOT EXPLODE.'

choices.label: Do the interviews
choices.result: The story runs with a great photo. Donations come in. The whiteboard is in the shot.

choices.label: Politely decline
choices.result: You send a kind no. The whiteboard stays a secret. Phew!

speaker: crew_jittery

flavor.amara: I'm fine. Easy. I only checked my helmet six times.
flavor.jun: Technically, my hands are not shaking. The table is.
flavor.lucia: Breathe. Then decide. I keep getting stuck on the breathe part.
flavor.dmitri: In my day, we did not get nervous. We got quiet. I am very quiet.
flavor.priya: Sorry, quick question. Is it normal to dream about countdowns?
flavor.sam: Roger that, boss. Totally calm. Why is my coffee vibrating?
flavor.zainab: One more check. And one more after that. I can't seem to stop.
flavor.mateo: I keep thinking I forgot something. Wait, did we do that? Did I do that?

title: Launch nerves
text: Launch is close and nerves are showing. Even the calmest people are a little jumpy this week.

choices.label: Arrange a talk with Rosa
choices.result: A long talk and a cup of tea. Nerves are normal, and now everyone knows it.

choices.label: Push on
choices.result: Training goes on. The worry comes along for the ride. Whoopty-doo!

speaker: marty
flavor: Free parts, boss! They said keep them! Nobody panic. Nobody call them back, either.
title: A lucky mistake
text: A supplier mistakenly set bonus parts by mistake and says to keep them. Shipping them back would cost more.

choices.label: Take the free parts
choices.result: You sell the spares for a tidy sum. Sometimes luck just shows up.

speaker: dev
flavor: Cool cool cool. I heard 'launch,' 'chicken' and 'Tuesday.' That can't be right.
title: The radio keeps cutting out
text: A practice call on the capsule's budget radio comes through in pieces. Half the words go missing.

choices.label: Add a booster antenna on the ground
choices.result: A big dish goes up beside Mission Control. The next call is crisp.

choices.label: Teach the crew code words
choices.result: The crew learns short codes for bad radio days. 'Mango cakes' means 'say again.' I think?

choices.label: Live with it
choices.result: The radio stays crackly. Everyone agrees to speak slowly and hope. Fingers crossed.

speaker: hal
flavor: Who put a coffee maker in my capsule.
title: The capsule is gaining weight
text: The capsule is close to the rocket's weight limit, and little extras keep sneaking aboard. Today: a coffee maker, tomorrow: an air fryer.

choices.label: Weigh every item twice
choices.result: Two days with a scale and a clipboard. Every gram is now on a list.

choices.label: Ban all extras
choices.result: New rule: nothing extra goes aboard. The coffee maker stays behind. The crew sighs.

choices.label: Let it slide
choices.result: Nobody checks. The capsule may be heavier than the paperwork says.

speaker: inez
flavor: The battery has no room to spare. I have a checklist for this. Trust, but verify.
title: The battery is nearly maxed out
text: A power test shows the battery is almost fully used. Switch on one more thing and something else switches off.

choices.label: Run a full power test
choices.result: Every switch is tried in every order. Now the team knows exactly what the battery can take.

choices.label: Write a power-saving checklist
choices.result: The crew learns what to switch off first. The reading lamp loses the vote. Hehe.

choices.label: Trust the numbers
choices.result: The numbers say it just fits. Just.
